learning_objective: 🎯 Unleash your creativity and learn the magic of block coding to build your very own animated stories and digital games!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Scratch is a super fun coding platform where you do not have to type confusing words. Instead, you snap colorful blocks together like digital Lego pieces to make things happen!
A Sprite is your main character on the screen. It can be a cat, a spaceship, or even a dancing dinosaur. You are the boss and you tell the Sprite exactly what to do.
When you connect a 'move 10 steps' block to a 'play sound' block, you create a script. The computer reads these blocks top-to-bottom and brings your animation to life.

fun_activity.title: 👾 The Scratch Dance Party
fun_activity.instructions: Log into Scratch or draw it on paper! Design a quick program where your character moves 10 steps, turns 15 degrees, and says 'Hello!' to start a mini dance routine.

quick_recap: ⭐ Coding is just giving a set of simple instructions to a computer.
⭐ Scratch uses colorful blocks to make programming easy and highly creative.
⭐ Sprites are digital characters you can animate to tell amazing stories.
